review_candidates.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Active Directory Engineer to take ownership of our enterprise Directory Services infrastructure. In this role, you will be in charge across a complex, multi-domain, multi-forest environment. You will be responsible for ensuring the high availability, security posture, compliance, and seamless operational performance of active directory instances, identity sync pipelines, and directory-integrated services. Architecture & Operations Design, implement, and maintain multi-forest and multi-domain Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) architectures, including trust relationships, sites, subnets, and replication topologies. Act as an operational tier-3 escalation point for all identity, authentication, and directory services issues across global infrastructure. Manage and maintain Active Directory (AD), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), and Domain Name System (DNS) integrated with AD. Architect, test, and manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to enforce security baselines, standard configurations, and user environments across server and endpoint fleets. Security & Privileged Access Serve as a primary custodian of Tier-0 privileged accounts (Enterprise Admin, Domain Admin, Schema Admin). Enforce Least Privilege Access models and Tiered Administration (Tier 0, Tier 1, Tier 2 architecture) to eliminate cross-tier compromise vectors. Perform hardening against directory attack vectors (e.g., Kerberoasting, AS-REP Roasting, DCSync, Pass-the-Hash) using security frameworks Monitor directory change auditing tools and integrate logs with Enterprise SIEM for real-time threat detection and remediation. Hybrid Identity & Integration Manage hybrid identity integration, including Microsoft Entra Connect (Azure AD Connect), password hash synchronization (PHS), pass-through authentication (PTA), or ADFS. Oversee identity lifecycle management and cross-domain migration/consolidation projects (mergers, acquisitions, or enterprise restructurings). Disaster Recovery & Maintenance Design, document, and regularly test forest-level and domain-level Disaster Recovery (DR) plans using native tools and third-party recovery software. Perform routine health checks, schema extensions, functional level upgrades, and Domain Controller patching/lifecycle management. Please provide your English resume.
